fixed: A weight typed as "32.5 oz (921 g)" is one weight, not two — pasting a spec line no longer doubles the row.
A number that names no unit is no longer added to the weight beside it: "size 2 / 400 g" is 400 g.
A long item name with nothing to break on now wraps instead of running off the side of the screen, on a shared list and in packing mode.
A folder name with no spaces in it stays inside the category legend.
A very large total no longer has its last digits and its unit cut off the edge of a phone screen.
A JSON backup restores a quantity of zero as zero, so a restored list weighs what the file said.
Exporting to CSV and importing it back keeps a row you weighed but haven't named yet, and keeps weights under a gram.
An item name can no longer carry hidden characters that reverse how it reads — what a list shows is what it says.
A person or folder named with an invisible character now falls back to a readable name instead of a blank chip.
An edit that used to fail to save now saves.
The trail link under a list title is easier to read in dark mode.
Searching the gear catalog without accents — "fjallraven" — now highlights the match it found.
The Base / Worn / Consumable line stays inside the preview card a shared link unfurls, however heavy the pack.
